parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the firewall policy.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this {{object}} entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error_Misconfigured}} value indicates that a necessary configuration value is undefined or invalid. The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Chain
parameters.description: The Chain containing Firewall Rules associated with this {{object}} entry. This is applicable for traffic from the {{param|SourceInterface}} to the {{param|DestinationInterface}}. {{param}} only applies when {{param|TargetChain}} is {{enum|Chain|TargetChain}}.

parameters.name: TargetChain
parameters.description: Action to perform for traffic matching this {{object}} entry. {{enum}}

parameters.name: SourceInterface
parameters.description: This specifies the L3 source interface associated with the entry.

parameters.name: DestinationInterface
parameters.description: This specifies the L3 destination interface associated with the entry.

parameters.name: IPVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the IP protocol version, following the definitions in {{bibref|IANA-ipversionnumbers}}. Valid values are: {{range}}.

parameters.name: ReverseChain
parameters.description: The Chain containing Firewall Rules associated with this {{object}} entry. This is applicable for traffic from the {{param|DestinationInterface}} to the {{param|SourceInterface}}. {{param}} only applies when {{param|ReverseTargetChain}} is {{enum|Chain|ReverseTargetChain}}.

parameters.name: ReverseTargetChain
parameters.description: Action to perform for traffic matching this {{object}} entry.

parameters.name: Log
parameters.description: Enable or disable logging, in a {{object|.DeviceInfo.VendorLogFile}}, of packets matching this {{object}}.

parameters.name: LogRef
parameters.description: Specifies the logging rules for this {{object}} entry. The {{param|Log}} parameter MUST be set to {{true}} for this setting to take effect. When {{param|Log}} is {{true}} and {{param}} is {{empty}} or contains an invalid reference, the system MUST treat the configuration as an error and set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.

object.description: Firewall Policy table. When a {{enum|Policy|#.Config}} configuration is selected, {{param|#.PolicyLevel}} selects the currently active entry in this table. Each {{object}} table entry references the {{object|#.Chain}} that contains the rules for this policy.
